description: POKT Network Intelligence: live Pocket Network (Shannon) chain state as JSON. Network pulse, governance and tokenomics parameters, validators, suppliers, applications, relay throughput, per-service supply and demand, and a 0-100 trust score for one supplier. Read live from Pocket's public indexer and LCD on each cache expiry; no hardcoded chain values. Endpoints and shapes: the OpenAPI spec in specs[].

rpc_types.notes: POST /v1/{pulse,tokenomics,validators,suppliers,throughput,applications,service-demand,supplier-trust}; GET /v1/version, /v1/health. JSON body only; errors are 4xx JSON, never 5xx.

serving.backend: Image ghcr.io/organiccryptoyyc/pokt-network-intel:1.1.1 (Node, no dependencies, no keys, no state) behind a RelayMiner at http://<container>:8080. One container per network: set POCKET_NETWORK=beta. Needs outbound HTTPS to Pocket's public indexer and LCD, or your own via POCKET_LCD_URL, POCKET_RPC_URL, POCKET_INDEXER_URL.

healthcheck.notes: Network probe: the backend must read Beta (POCKET_NETWORK=beta).
Functional probe: reads a live governance parameter.

serving.notes: Responses are cached 15s to 1h per endpoint; a failed refresh serves the last good value tagged cache.stale for at most 1 hour (POCKET_MAX_STALE_MS), then returns 422. Gateways: passthrough, rpc_types ["rest"].
